conviction_note: One small negative: the Pendergrass timeline has slipped a quarter across the company's own releases (June 22: site acceptance testing done by end of August, ramp starting Q3 CY26; Sept 17: testing 'underway', ramp 'remains on track' for Q4 CY26), while the only FY27 revenue consensus I could find is still $102M. I sized it -1.5 and emit -1.0, because both releases are public, the stock has already given back 4.6% since the Sept 17 close ($3.49 to $3.33), and the call will be full of new SK On and Infinite Grid backlog talk that could outweigh it. The reported-quarter number (bar $1.27M) is too small to move a ~$196M stock that trades on the factory.
bar: Q4 FY26 (Apr-Jun 2026) revenue $1.27M, EPS -$0.09: Benzinga/Webull preview https://www.webull.com/news/15592369761764352 and TradingView https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:0f3e4539177cc:0-neov-q4-26-earnings-eps-estimate-is-0-09-usd/ ; matches stockanalysis FY26 revenue $14.58M less nine-month actual $13.3M = $1.28M implied Q4 (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/neov/forecast/). FY27 consensus $102.29M comes from stockanalysis alone, and there is no company guide, so the guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: MarketBeat, settlement 2026-08-31: 4,568,099 shares short, 8.41% of float, 2.4 days to cover, down 6.21% month on month (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NEOV/short-interest). The short is not crowded. Skew is -8.78 vol points (calls bid over puts) with put/call open interest of 0.25: retail upside demand, not downside protection. The negative sign goes with a call-heavy long, not against a put skew. Options are thin (1,785 open interest, 40% ATM spread), so the 22.75% implied move is indicative only.

findings.finding: The company's own dates for the Georgia (Pendergrass) factory have slipped about a quarter. On June 22 it said site acceptance testing would be done by end of August 2026 and the production ramp would start in Q3 CY2026 (May 14 said the same Q3 ramp). On Sept 17, testing was still 'underway' and the ramp 'remains on track for the fourth quarter of calendar 2026'. The only FY27 (Jul 2026-Jun 2027) revenue consensus found is still $102.29M, against a factory that has not yet shipped and a $53M binding reservation that covers all of calendar 2027.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print isolates the factory timeline. The last print (2026-05-14, amc) missed revenue ($2.0M vs a $4.5M estimate) with the ramp still on its original date, and the baseline shows -9.22%. Prior prints were +4.75% and 0.0%. The Sept 17 release (reservation plus 'on track Q4') closed +5.4% and then gave back 4.6% over four sessions.
findings.why_not_priced: The company framed the new date as 'remains on track' and the wire headlines repeated it ('production ramp on track for Q4 2026'), so no piece of wire copy reports a slip; you see it only by putting the June 22 and Sept 17 releases side by side. If the slip were priced, the FY27 revenue consensus would have come down from $102M; stockanalysis still shows $102.29M from 5 analysts, and the most recent note (Needham, Sept 15) came before the Sept 17 release. The call is the first place analysts can ask for a first-shipment date and FY27 revenue. Against that, the stock has already faded since Sept 17, so some of this may be priced, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: Second company document on the earlier date: the June 22 release, 'SAT targeted for completion by the end of August 2026, with production ramp on track to begin in Q3 of calendar year 2026' (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/NEOV/neo-volta-confirms-feoc-compliance-at-georgia-manufacturing-facility-nvxep2hf075h.html ; https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/neovolta-confirms-feoc-compliance-georgia-manufacturing-facility-commissioning-track). The same company, so this is one line of evidence read twice, not two findings. The FY27 consensus is a separate source: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/neov/forecast/

outside_window.finding: Infinite Grid Capital (IGC) has three roles: it is the 'binding' $53M customer for 2027, it holds 4.5M shares (4.0M bought in a Feb 2026 private placement at $2.50, plus 0.5M paid for 'offtake origination' consulting), and those shares are registered for resale under an S-3 filed Aug 11. That is a backlog-quality concern and a supply overhang that plays out as IGC sells, not on the print.

The $20M Horizon/ROHO/Monroe term loan (10%, matures 2028-03-03, 1.45M warrants at $3.30, $5M minimum-cash covenant) was disclosed only in an 8-K (Sept 4), with no press release. It funds the Phase 3 JV contributions (up to $25M through June 2027), backed by the SK On and IGC agreements, so it is funding a ramp and makes an equity raise less likely soon. The May raise came 13 days after that print, which would also have been outside this window.

searched_and_found_nothing: Q4 residential or C&I shipment evidence: no NeoVolta press release on residential or third-party-ownership orders between May and Sept; the Luminia page (https://luminia.io/commercial-energy-storage-partnership-neovolta/) gives no delivery dates, so the $1.9M order's timing against the $1.27M bar cannot be established

10-K / going-concern language: the 10-K is not filed yet (EDGAR submissions API, latest filing 2026-09-04); the Q3 10-Q said cash covers 12 months (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1748137/000168316826003941/neovolta_i10q-033126.htm)

Form 4s: director open-market buys at $1.92-$1.99 in June (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1748137/000168316826004803/xslF345X06/ownership.xml), old news with the stock since doubled; no Form 4 after June 12

Treasury FEOC / 45X guidance inside the window: none; the PFE safe-harbor tables are due by 2026-12-31 (https://www.novoco.com/notes-from-novogradac/managing-the-interim-feoc-guidance-irs-notice-2026-15-addresses-material-assistance-for-sections-45y-48e-and-45x-deferring-on-broader-pfe-status-guidance)
SK On deal (Aug 31) and Needham/Northland/Lake Street targets: all on the wire, priced
baseline_tension: The finding goes with a call-heavy positioning (skew -8.78, put/call OI 0.25) and against the +6.7% 20-day run-up. But the stock has already faded 4.6% since the Sept 17 release that contains the slip, which suggests the market has partly priced it; that is why the emitted move is smaller than the finding.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (verify the bar): the finding lands on FY27 guidance, which has no company guide and a single-source consensus (stockanalysis), so the finding is capped small: -2.0 cut to -1.5.
Rule 3 and the pessimism note: the only finding is negative and its own why_not_priced admits a 4.6% fade since Sept 17, so the emitted move is set visibly below the sum (-1.0 vs -1.5).

Rule 4 (financing is a question): the Sept 4 term loan checked out as funding a ramp backed by SK On and IGC, so it was left at 0 in outside_window rather than signed either way; this confirmed the draft's choice not to count it.
Rule 7 (positioning): short interest confirmed at 8.41% of float, 2.4 days to cover, not crowded; no shrink needed for squeeze risk.
Left standing: lands_on=guidance, and the IGC overhang stays in outside_window (Rule 6).
